'''Blue Smuggler I Know A Few Maneuvers.''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Blue Smuggler]]
* '''Published:''' 24 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed WYS Smuggler LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

WYS/TPCBALR with Asteroids and circular force retrieval.

== Strategy ==

The idea is to eliminate opposition in space via destiny adders during battles (and my average is really high, thank you A Few Maneuvers)and knocking out unsuspecting ships (ie. Executer) by drawing Asteroid Sectors for asteriod destiny. Then set up legendary starfighter, leebo, asteroid sanc. in space where they're safe and begin circular retrieval with kessel and rycar's runs. Make Kessel runs early to flip wys and keep it flipped. Use Luke, Chewie to jump opponent on tat and at his sites if necessary with Phylo for support against Maul, while draining away in space.
